newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - West Orange, N.J.

text.p: SEALED BIDS will be received by the Chief Financial Officer, Township of West Orange, County of Essex, New Jersey (the
West Orange, 66 Main Street, West Orange, New Jersey 07052, on
until 11:00 a.m. (Eastern Standard Time) for the purchase of the Township's General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds'') as more fully described in the full Notice of Sale:
DENOMINATIONS: $5,000 each or integral multiples thereof, except as to that portion of the Bonds which if not divisible by $5,000 will be in the denomination of $1,000 or integral multiples thereof.
Year Principal Year Principal Year Principal

REDEMPTION: The Bonds maturing on or before January 1, 200 are not subject to redemption prior to maturity. The Bonds maturing on or after January 1, 2008 are subject to redemption prior to maturity, at the option of the Township in whole or in part, on any date on or after January 1, 2007 and in such order of maturity as the Township shall select and, within each maturity, by lot or any other method deemed fair and appropriate by the Township, at the redemption price expressed as a percentage of the principal amount thereof, set opposite the respective redemption period in the following table, together with accrued interest:

INTEREST: The Bonds will bear interest at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable initially on July 1, 1997 and semiannually thereafter on January 1 and July 1 in each year until maturity. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.
Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and

Township's full Notice of Sale, containing additional terms and conditions of the public sale, may be obtained at the Township of West Orange, 66 Main Street, West Orange, New Jersey 07052, telephone number (201)325-4070.
